question: List the card names with value that cost more converted mana for the face.
evidence: more converted mana for the face refers to Max(faceConvertedManaCost);
clarification: If several rows tie at the cut-off, return all of them.
gold: SELECT c0 FROM (SELECT name AS c0, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY faceConvertedManaCost) AS __r FROM cards) AS __t WHERE __r <= 1
gold0: SELECT name FROM cards ORDER BY faceConvertedManaCost LIMIT 1

c.sql: SELECT name FROM cards WHERE faceConvertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(faceConvertedManaCost) FROM cards)

b.request: Which card names have a faceConvertedManaCost equal to the maximum faceConvertedManaCost across all cards, including every card that ties for that maximum value?
b.sql: SELECT DISTINCT name FROM cards WHERE faceConvertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(faceConvertedManaCost) FROM cards)

d.request: List the names of the cards whose face converted mana cost equals the maximum face converted mana cost (Max(faceConvertedManaCost)), and if several cards tie for that maximum value, return all of them.
d.sql: SELECT name FROM cards WHERE faceConvertedManaCost = (SELECT MAX(faceConvertedManaCost) FROM cards)
